renderer_rule: Initial dchey is an action default unless an immediately bound value makes it a nominal measured result; the identical medial surface is nominal, and a line boundary resets the default.
A process-rich result does not open a second imperative after an already explicit action.
QOL is the add action and the left item is its object; fused QOL+SHEEDY contains one add action plus one finished moist object.
Attach only to the nearest compatible visible head; DY closes the value field and no attachment jumps an unknown head or action.
OL is nominal and never an action by itself; select local wood only when another visible L/wood cue licenses it.
Each exact action head resets scope; intervening state/result tokens remain nominal.
Without a visible action head the line is a catalogue/record, not an implicit command.
